results.title: Kim Deal Reveals New Live Album and Concert Film
results.description: Live At The Barbican captures a London show that the artist played in March 2025, backed by a 25-piece musical ensemble Photo by Steve Gullick Kim Deal is releasing a live album and concert film, Live At The Barbican. Both were captured during a London show that the US artists played at London's Barbican in March 2025, which saw a 25-piece musical ensemble join her to perform orchestral renditions of tracks from 2024 album Nobody Loves You More, as well as The Breeders' back catalogue. Speaking about the show in a statement, Deal said: "I invited myself! That’s how I came to play Nobody Loves You More at the Barbican.
